name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Revert Federation dashboard UI to the pre-redesign (0.0.82) layout — the 0.0.83 hero/pill and 0.0.84 Catalog redesigns were reverted per your request. This is the plain utilitarian dashboard that matched native Jellyfin: sectionTitle/fieldDescription/inputContainer/emby-* controls, underline tabs, 0.35em callouts, no gradients/shadows/animations. Backend for Incoming content filters / per-friend + per-user download + per-user rating ceilings (Services/IncomingContentFilterService, RemoteAccessControlService, FederationPeerAccessService, FederationSyncService) stays in this build but is no longer surfaced in the UI until a new frontend is wired up — upgrading hides nothing, and federated item delete propagation (rm on source → pruned on next sync via PruneServerSources → ReconcileMappingAsync) is unchanged. No functional change beyond the UI revert.
